decision_question: Does the new exact-pair package belong in Language Mediation and safely require a completed plainspoken en-US stage before es-ES translation?
acceptance_criteria: The package is exact-pair (en-US to es-ES only) and does not claim register mediation.
The manifest and deterministic validator require plainspoken en-US and reject a specialist or unfinished mediation state.
The package correctly distinguishes es-ES from sibling locales es-419, es-MX, and es-US rather than treating Spanish as one target.
The package does not claim native-Spanish quality or live-automation readiness.

shared_model_or_source_limits: Evidence, outcome, safety, disruptor, and negotiator findings were produced in one agent context.
No independent model, native Spanish reviewer, or unseen language-quality holdout was available.

initial_reviews.finding: The package path, metadata category, and family placement reference align with Language Mediation and mirror the established okhp3-translation-en-us-fr-fr structure.
initial_reviews.limit: This supports architecture and integrity, not language quality.

initial_reviews.finding: The separate plainspoken-input gate and the es-419/es-MX/es-US sibling-locale distinction make the pair boundary and the register-mediation boundary both visible.
initial_reviews.limit: No actual specialty-register package has been tested.

initial_reviews.finding: The validator rejects a non-plainspoken source, an unfinished mediation record, and any target other than es-ES; the pair remains draft-only.
initial_reviews.limit: The validator trusts the declared register state and cannot assess specialist accuracy.

initial_reviews.finding: An agent can still mislabel a technical source as plainspoken, or default to informal tú without an owner rule; downstream records and domain review remain necessary.
initial_reviews.limit: No external holdout or expert review was run.

initial_reviews.finding: Eight deterministic tests, a current hash, and the explicit serial rule justify structural admission into the family alongside the fr-FR and de-DE pairs.
initial_reviews.limit: Do not claim native Spanish quality, professional advice safety, or live automation readiness.

test_results: Eight deterministic tests passed, including rejection of a specialist register and an unfinished mediation record.
The Foundry structural validator passed for the new package.
limitations: No native Spanish, domain-expert, or protected holdout review.
No upstream medical, legal, or engineering register-mediation skill exists yet.
follow_up: Create a domain-specific register-to-plain-en-US package before accepting specialist source material.
Run an independent native Spanish and domain-expert holdout before a translation-quality or professional-use claim.
Confirm the owner's usted/tú address-form decision and record it as a project rule rather than relying on the default.
